name: leakhound
description: Finds where your Claude Code tokens actually go. /waste breaks down a session's token burn, /mcp-audit and /plugin-audit flag MCP servers and plugins you never use, /model-audit shows which model should do which work (with optional $ figures and delegation compliance), /trend tracks it over time, /live puts a real-time context meter in your statusline. Zero hooks, zero per-prompt cost — the automatic layers ship separately as leakhound-router (per-prompt routing) and leakhound-guard (waste firewall).
